sources.quote: Iota Coronae Borealis is a binary star system in the northern constellation of Corona Borealis.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 3.8 solar radii and 3.16 solar masses (FLAME) and 10,514 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
